[Arbiter]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}

[A half-orc clad in plate armor uses his maul to land a devastating blow
against the ogre. He quickly shifts into a defensive stance, his weapons
flash a bright white light. Suddenly he is holding a longsword and
shield, ready to deflect the ogre's attacks to protect his
allies.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}[![](data:image/jpeg;base64,){style="width: 420.29px; height: 420.29px; margin-left: 0.00px; margin-top: 0.00px; transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); -webkit-transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px);"}]{style="overflow: hidden; display: inline-block; margin: 0.00px 0.00px; border: 0.00px solid #000000; transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); -webkit-transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); width: 420.29px; height: 420.29px;"}

[A tiefling wearing studded leather armor draws her bow back and shoots
an arrow through the gaps in a warlord's armor. As soon as the arrow
leaves her bow, she breaks into a sprint, charging at the warlord. As
the arrow hits the warlord, she plunges a dagger through his chest,
swiftly behind the arrow as if performed in a single
stroke.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[A dragonborn armored in scale mail slices off one of a beholder's
eyestalks with a flaming sword. Before the beholder gets a chance to
respond, a bolt of lightning, fired from the dragonborn's crossbow,
strikes its central eye, closing it
forever.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[No matter what form an Arbiter takes, they use their ability to switch
between tactics and weapons to surprise their foes and adapt to a
chaotic battlefield. While others might struggle to readjust quickly,
Arbiters thrive in an unrelenting and unpredictable
fight.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### [Versatile Champions]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.s2d8nyl4j2f2 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Most warriors spend their days honing their expertise in a single
weapon, practicing the alignment of their sword's edge, honing their
fists into lethal weapons, or perfecting their aim with a longbow.
Arbiters believe that a jack of all trades is often superior to a master
of one, using their wide breadth of knowledge to give them an edge no
matter what happens on the battlefield. Arbiters are trained in every
type of armor and weapon available and are able to switch between
weapons at a moment's notice. Arbiters can even augment their armor to
enhance their tactical prowess. An arbiter\'s armor augmentations are
unique to their training, whether they descended from an ancient order
of similar knights, or if they stumbled upon this power while exploring
ancient tombs or
ruins.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### [Protectors of the Realms]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.j5mb0n4259l2 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[The magic of
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}[requipping]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}[ was
discovered long ago by knights looking for a way to harness the power of
extradimensional spaces. Since then, these knights have taken on the
responsibility of protecting the realms from evil within and without.
They keep vast records of extraplanar forces and creatures. These orders
are often small and kept secret from the majority of commoners in order
to keep themselves
safe.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[        Hailing from an ancient order isn\'t the only way to become an
Arbiter. Many arbiters discover their power through experimentation with
bags of holding or similar magical items. Some discover the power by
happenstance while spelunking in ancient ruins or reading dusty old
tombs.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### [Creating an Arbiter]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.q359l7hrzam style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[As you build your Arbiter, think about how you discovered this power:
Were you knight descended from an ancient order of protectors? Were you
the product of magical experimentation by a powerful wizard? Was this
power passed down to you through your bloodline or from a wise older
tutor? What drove you to learn and master this power? A sense of duty, a
code of honor, or just a rabid curiosity could all be reasons for
developing your skills as an
arbiter.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[        What drew you to the adventuring lifestyle? Were you sent on a
wild goose chase by a wealthy patron? Did your order task you to go out
and protect the innocent? Are you seeking to avenge the death of a loved
one or mentor who was taken away by a powerful foe? Consider how your
character fits into the narrative and talk with your DM about how you
might have learned this
power.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[When you take the
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}A[ttack action
on your turn, you can magically summon a
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[et of
weapons into your hands. You can do this before each attack you make on
your turn. Each time you summon a new
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[et of
weapons, the former
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[et
disappears back into an extradimensional space, called an
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}A[rmory.
]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}[![](data:image/jpeg;base64,){style="width: 347.00px; height: 346.43px; margin-left: 0.00px; margin-top: -21.22px; transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); -webkit-transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px);"}]{style="overflow: hidden; display: inline-block; margin: 0.00px 0.00px; border: 0.00px solid #000000; transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); -webkit-transform: rotate(0.00rad) translateZ(0px); width: 347.00px; height: 319.34px;"}

thrown, it returns to your hand immediately after it hits or misses its
target. You cannot be disarmed of any weapons or shields summoned from

condition.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

level determines the number of
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[ets that you
can store in your
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}A[rmory at one
time, as shown in the Weapon Sets column of the Arbiter table.
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}[A
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[et of
weapons can contain any number of Simple weapons,
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Martial
[weapons ]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}or
Sh[ields that you can
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}wield [at one
time. For example, you can have a one handed weapon and a
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}S[hield, two
one handed weapons that have the
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}L[ight
property, or ]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}a
[two handed weapon in a single
set]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}.

[You can change the weapons that are in your
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Armory at the
end of a Short or Long Rest [by touching a new
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Set [and
magically sending
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}it[ into the
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Armory.[ If
there are no free spaces in the
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Armory[, doing

## []{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.55c939mnb14c style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;height:16pt;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

### Level 1: [Fighting Style]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.8c3ismna4lks style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You adopt a particular style of fighting as your specialty.
You]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""} gain a
Fighting Style feat of your choice. You gain this feature again at
Arbiter levels 5, 9, 13, and 18.

### Level 1: [Weapon Mastery]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.e1kdemretrwk style="padding-top:12pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:2pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Your training with weapons allows you to use the mastery properties of
three kinds of Simple or Martial weapons of your choice. Whenever you
finish a Long Rest, you can practice weapon drills and change one of
those weapon
choices.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

When you reach certain Arbiter  levels, you gain the ability to use the
mastery properties of more kinds of weapons, as shown in the Weapon
Mastery column of the Arbiter Features table.

### Level 2: Phase Step {#h.i4r8h9f8bhfb style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

Once per turn, when you use your Requip feature, you can move up to 10
feet as part of your movement without provoking Opportunity Attacks.
This movement occurs immediately before you make your first attack with
the newly equipped weapon.

Y[ou choose a
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}K[night\'s
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}C[reed that
represents the order of arbiters that you hail from or the source of
your magical power. Choose Armor of the Giant\'s Bulwark, Armor of the
Dreadful Duelist, or Armor of the
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}Elemental
[Emperor, all detailed at the end of the class description. Some of the
features granted to you by your
Knight]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}'s Creed
require a saving throw, The DC for these saving throws is 8 + your
Proficiency Bonus + your Intelligence modifier.[ The
]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}C[reed you
choose grants you features at 3rd level and again at 6th, 9th, 15th, and
17th
level.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### Level 4: [Ability Score Improvement]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.3wtfp5gly78x style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You gain the Ability Score Improvement feat or another feat of your
choice for which you qualify. You gain this feature again at Arbiter
levels 8, 12, 14, and 16.

### Level 5: [Extra Attack]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.5nzilz797l8j style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Beginning at 5th level, you can attack twice, instead of once, whenever
you take the Attack action on your
turn.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### Level 7: [Improved Requip]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.wpj800uym3ic style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}I[ncapacitated.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### Level 10: Planar [Synergy]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.57yyx7axf55i style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Your Requip leaves behind dimensional traces that bolster the damage

]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}W[eapon

### [Level 18: Duet]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.ovi0ylqkkndg style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You can instantly warp yourself to your Dancing Weapon. If your Dancing
Weapon is active and the weapon is within 60 feet of you, you can
teleport to it. Once per turn, when you Requip, you teleport to the
Dancing Weapon's location and equip the Weapon Set that was animated.
The Weapon Set you had equipped before teleporting now acts as your
Dancing Weapon and stays in the space you occupied before teleporting
until you command it to move.

### [Level 19: Epic Boon]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.1a9wpyss8xw2 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[You gain an Epic Boon feat or another feat of your choice for which you
qualify. Boon of Irresistible Offense is
recommended.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### Level 20: [Planar Onslaught]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""} {#h.b7j62w8q3lnx style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

You Requip with uncanny speed and precision which causes your weapons to
radiate destructive magic, bolstering your attacks. When you Requip, you
can enter a state of heightened power. While in this state, the bonus
damage granted by Planar Synergy increases by 1d8 each time you use
Requip again after you activate this ability. This state lasts for 1
minute or until you take a turn where you don't use Requip. Once you
enter this state, you must finish a Short or Long rest before you do so
again

## [Knight]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}'[s Creeds]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:16pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.ku09lnacmrq5 style="padding-top:18pt;margin:0;color:#000000;padding-left:0;font-size:16pt;padding-bottom:6pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Different orders of arbiters draw their power from various sources of
magic. Your choice in creed reflects the order you hail from or the
source of your

### [Armor of the Giants Bulwark]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.pefu95shhck7 style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Arbiters who wield the Giant's Bulwark armors use their strength and
resilience to outlast their foes. They specialize in being right in the
middle of the battlefield, swinging large weapons at even larger
enemies. These Arbiters tend to work in teams with archers and mages,
drawing fire, so their allies have space to lay down barrages of arrows
and powerful
spells.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

### [Armor of the Dreadful Duelist]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.6ns5qh1bbwus style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Arbiters who wield the Dreadful Duelist armors are excellent at
infiltration and trickery. They are often on the side of the underdog,
taking out powerful enemies who disparage and harm the innocent.
Dreadful Duelists use their enhanced speed and accuracy to strike foes
from afar or dash in for the killing
blow.]{style="font-weight:400;font-family:\"Times New Roman\""}

### [Armor of the Planar Warden]{style="color:#434343;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:14pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.k9g0p6whzzxi style="padding-top:16pt;margin:0;color:#434343;padding-left:0;font-size:14pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[Arbiters who wield the Planar Warden Armors connect to the higher
planes of Order, Divinity, and Chaos to protect their allies and hold
the line against extraplanar threats. They use their powers to fend off
invaders from other realms and keep their realm safe. Orders of these
Arbiters will often work with Paladins, Wizards, and Clerics to
establish wards and armies to contain and prevent extraplanar entities
from seizing the Material
Plane.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

#### [Level 3: Enhanced Armor]{style="color:#666666;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.92zg3tmytjtn style="padding-top:14pt;margin:0;color:#666666;padding-left:0;font-size:12pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[        You gain access to three Armor Types, which are magical
augmentations to whatever armor you are wearing. You have three choices,
which get stronger as you increase in level. You can only have one Armor
Type active at a time and you choose which type is active when you roll
initiative or as an action outside of combat. The three armor types
granted by this creed are listed
below.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[Chaos.]{style="font-weight:700"} Once per turn, when you make an attack
roll with Advantage, you can force the target to subtract 1d4 from the
next saving throw it makes before the end of your next turn, provided
that the attack hits it.

[Divinity. ]{style="font-weight:700"}Once per turn, when you hit a
creature while you[ are within 10 feet of one of your allies, you can
deal an extra 1d8 Radiant or Necrotic damage (your choice) to the
target.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[Order. ]{style="font-weight:700"}[Once per turn, when you make an
attack roll with a weapon, you can forgo rolling the d20 to get an 8 on
the
die.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

#### [Level 6: Creed Focus]{style="color:#666666;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.vt7jk3wqyp0x style="padding-top:14pt;margin:0;color:#666666;padding-left:0;font-size:12pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[        You can temporarily traverse the planes to reposition yourself.
As a Bonus Action, you can teleport to an unoccupied space you can see
within a number of feet equal to 5 times your Arbiter level. You can use
this feature a number of times equal to your Intelligence modifier and
regain all uses when you finish a Long
Rest.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

#### [Level 9: Improved Armor]{style="color:#666666;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"} {#h.2jm7q74wnjpy style="padding-top:14pt;margin:0;color:#666666;padding-left:0;font-size:12pt;padding-bottom:4pt;line-height:1.5;page-break-after:avoid;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";orphans:2;widows:2;text-align:left;padding-right:0"}

[        Your Armor Types grow in power to match your increase in skill.
You gain additional features, benefits, or improvements upon your Armor
Types. Previous features do not get replaced, unless stated
otherwise.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[Chaos.]{style="font-weight:700"} When you Requip, you can choose to
switch to a random Weapon Set in your Armory, rather than choosing. When
you do you, you have Advantage on your next attack roll made with the
randomly chosen weapons in that set.[ Use a dice or other random
selection tool to determine which Weapon Set you switch to, assigning
each Weapon Set that is currently in your Armory the same
probability.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[Divinity. ]{style="font-weight:700"}[Once per turn, when you deal
Radiant or Necrotic damage to a creature, you can mark them until the
start of your turn. While marked, the next attack made against the
target gains a 1d4 bonus to the attack roll. The mark ends early if the
target is hit by an
attack.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}

[Order. ]{style="font-weight:700"}[When you miss an attack roll, you
gain a +1 bonus to the next attack roll you make before the end of your
next
turn.]{style="color:#000000;font-weight:400;text-decoration:none;vertical-align:baseline;font-size:12pt;font-family:\"Times New Roman\";font-style:normal"}
